Viewer-scoped drafts/preferences/mute/archive use authenticated CAS and multi-device synchronization, preserving public conversation facts and current write/read permissions.

requirements.original_statement: snapshot 与 event cursor 在同一一致性边界创建；重连 replay 支持重复和断档，cursor 绑定身份/筛选/授权版本。
implementation_reviews: Frozen snapshot and high-water share a consistency boundary. Replay cursors bind identity/filter/auth state; dedup, revocation, resync and bounded slow-consumer behavior preserve authoritative Messages.

requirements.original_statement: 订阅、检索、聚合计数、附件和错误同样复核授权；撤销后不得继续发送正文，缓存失效可明确通知当前连接。
requirements.note: P1 新服务的鉴权/撤销必须完整；P0 既有 Domain/私信隔离不允许下降。
implementation_reviews: Frozen snapshot and high-water share a consistency boundary. Replay cursors bind identity/filter/auth state; dedup, revocation, resync and bounded slow-consumer behavior preserve authoritative Messages.

Current participant ACL and registration incarnation bracket local/remote source I/O; Receiver current technical-read policy is separate from expired input permission. Host read/control grants remain independent of ACS metadata or manager roles.

requirements.original_statement: 分页 stable keyset；snapshot 边界固定，后续增量走游标；不可按客户端时钟翻页，不能暴露外域序号推断私信流量。
implementation_reviews: Frozen snapshot and high-water share a consistency boundary. Replay cursors bind identity/filter/auth state; dedup, revocation, resync and bounded slow-consumer behavior preserve authoritative Messages.

requirements.original_statement: 正文搜索、附件和原生引用不扩大权限；附件需可信 digest、大小、content type 和传输到接收主机的可达性校验。
requirements.note: 二进制附件、全文搜索属于 P2；资源引用 ACL/真实原生数据访问仍受 P0 原安全约束。
implementation_reviews: Actual binary reservation/upload/finalize/download validates digest/size/MIME, ACL, quotas and lifecycle on the admitted Scope CAS. Arbitrary URL/local-path fetch is rejected. Communication attachments remain retrievable by authorized recipients; Native attachment conversion requires independently proven Host reachability and otherwise refuses before Native input.
Bounded indexed full-text Message search uses current participant ACL and stable authorized cursors; neither counts nor results expose inaccessible messages.

requirements.original_statement: ACS 消息与 native transcript 双源保留 distinct IDs、source、authority、独立 cursor；没有 linkage 不能靠正文相似度去重。
implementation_reviews: Authorized NativeLink/source provenance follows exact original Core dispatch plus local DriverJournal or authenticated remote readback. Concrete Orca source derives from its original signed Host admission receipt. Separate identifiers/cursors/Host permissions remain intact; no text-similarity inference.

Current participant ACL and registration incarnation bracket local/remote source I/O; Receiver current technical-read policy is separate from expired input permission. Host read/control grants remain independent of ACS metadata or manager roles.

requirements.original_statement: HTTP 新面与既有 MCP 使用同一领域服务和授权；客户端不能成为较弱入口。
implementation_reviews: Authenticated HTTP facade calls the same Domain and current permissions as MCP, with scope checks, bounded paging/body budgets, typed errors and original write keys; no parallel message ledger.

requirements.original_statement: 限制正文、分页、订阅缓冲、并发、重试与附件配额；背压必须可见，不能 ACK 后悄悄丢弃已提交消息。
requirements.note: 核心消息/投递的预算与背压为 P0；P2 二进制附件及个人事件的限额仅在模块启用时实施。
implementation_reviews: Independent maintenance advances due Messages under bounded scheduling and active-wait precedence. Repeated stopped-context restore archives lifecycle frames in the same Message Outbox, retaining original identity and possible-effect facts.

requirements.original_statement: 事件中字段缺失/unknown 保持未知；UI 不把“未观察”显示成空闲/完成。
implementation_reviews: Current profile/contact/receiver/delivery/operation/notice projections preserve unknown fields, exact private visibility and conditional permitted recovery actions.

requirements.original_statement: Codex/OpenCode 现有真实 Native 接入保留；支持声明精确到 OS/接入面/版本/授权模式。
implementation_reviews: Configured registered TLS peers retain original retry/ACK domains and bounded transport budgets. Current peer identity, signing-key/connection generation and readback are checked; absent mixed-version extensions fail typed and never fabricate an ACK.

requirements.original_statement: Orca Adapter 使用单一原生输入拥有者，不能与原生 Orchestration 同时投递同一消息。
implementation_reviews: The TypeScript Orca port and concrete Python existing-Core verifier/router provide trusted observe/admit/original reconcile composition on the existing Receiver ledger/TLS operations. Host owns serialized input and independent authorization; ACS does not own its Native Driver/PTY or mutate Orca storage.

Current participant ACL and registration incarnation bracket local/remote source I/O; Receiver current technical-read policy is separate from expired input permission. Host read/control grants remain independent of ACS metadata or manager roles.

requirements.original_statement: 完整 UI 清单覆盖数据/操作/事件/降级/测试；原生工具、审批、Diff、模型选择仍由宿主拥有。
requirements.note: UI 覆盖指 ACS 通信数据/动作与宿主 delegate/降级，非复制原生 Chat UI 后端；P2 功能仅标可选。
implementation_reviews: NativeView/Workspace delegate contracts cover Host-owned transcript/tool/Diff/approval/model/session/attachment actions with independent live Host grants and typed missing-port behavior; they do not copy Native state into ACS.
Production SDK headless consumers use actual OAuth HTTP/PG, all P1 operations, explicit replies, history/receipts, snapshots/events/reconnect/revocation and typed Native-source/delegate behavior.

All 30 source UI contracts map to ACS communication, activated P2 or an explicit Host delegate, with actions/data/events/degradation and contract witnesses. Product UI construction and actual Orca installation are not part of this backend pack.

requirements.original_statement: 插件 API 不足不以手工 PTY 输入/内部数据库注入冒充完整集成；host gap 明确归类。
implementation_reviews: The TypeScript Orca port and concrete Python existing-Core verifier/router provide trusted observe/admit/original reconcile composition on the existing Receiver ledger/TLS operations. Host owns serialized input and independent authorization; ACS does not own its Native Driver/PTY or mutate Orca storage.

requirements.original_statement: 显式迁移、兼容 reader、原消息 checksum/作者/关系不变；默认启动只校验版本。
implementation_reviews: Storage and DriverJournal adoption remain explicit and additive. Normal startup verifies. Existing namespaces with lost journals cannot be recreated; retained current/archived Core startup facts also prohibit reset.

requirements.original_statement: 恢复操作受权、幂等、有 expected revision、安全准入，失败不自动创建业务 Task 或换人完成。
implementation_reviews: Signed restore restarts only the proven stopped transport and resumes the exact retained Native session, including a positively known replacement session. Reconstructed factories reattest Core/profile/account/journal/complete-stop evidence. Explicit ready-target rebind remains a separately authorized CAS.

requirements.original_statement: 诊断最小暴露；日志无凭据/私信正文默认关闭；Manager notice 不包含第三方私信内容。
implementation_reviews: Configured registered TLS peers retain original retry/ACK domains and bounded transport budgets. Current peer identity, signing-key/connection generation and readback are checked; absent mixed-version extensions fail typed and never fabricate an ACK.

Participant-authorized diagnostics expose only technical layers/reasons/evidence. Inspect/reconcile query original work; recovery commands require current management authority, expected revision and durable idempotent acceptance.

requirements.original_statement: 真正模型/原生协议/受控 fixture/包自检证据分开；不可把模拟替代真实资格。
requirements.note: 开发证据分层在 P0/P1 各自强制，P2 不计入该轮两个完成 gate。
implementation_reviews: Evidence runners record commands, source bytes, original failures, component/controlled-integration boundaries and candidate package identity. Actual Native/platform/Host qualification is separately pending after the current code changes, as excluded from this development stopping condition.

requirements.original_statement: 受信接收能力变更必须重新确认；版本、二进制、主机、账号或连接代次变化使旧能力证据失效。
implementation_reviews: Typed adapter describe/observe captures actual profile, account, host, generation, evidence freshness and independent readiness axes. Unsupported and unknown never imply idle or input authority.

requirements.original_statement: Core 独立可用，关闭 Orca/UI 后消息持久性、等待恢复和维护器不消失。
